player_prompt.intro:
Ni wowe Mchezaji {player_id}. Uri kucheza umukino wa Battleship.
Intego yawe ni kuzamisha imbaraga zote za mushyikirwa wako mbere yuko azamishe nke.
Ku rundi yawe, urashobora kurasa misayili ku koordineti zihariye mu muryango ukiti: '[a4]'. Iki misayili ikigonga imbaraga, ibimenyweho 'X'. Ikiyitsa, ibimenyweho 'O'. Mu byombi, urwego rwa michezo rukaguhamagara kuri ibyo wavuze. Ikiwazamishe imbaraga, urwego rwa michezo rukaraguhamagara!
Umukino urarangira iyo imbaraga z'umwe mchezaji zote zikizamishwa.
Urugo rw'iboradi rwa mbere rugaragaza imbaraga zote z'awe zashyizwe na ibyo mushyikirwa wako yakuvuze, na ibyo wavuze na byo watsinze ku boradi ya mushyikirwa wako utabona imbaraga zake.
Hano urugo rw'iboradi rwa mbere:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umukinnyi ntiyasubije hamwe na coordinate yemewe mu nkingi.
